title.zh: PPSSPW · 基于 PPSSPP WebAssembly 的网页版 PSP 模拟器
title.en: PPSSPW · Browser PSP Emulator Based on PPSSPP WebAssembly

summary.zh: 在 PPSSPP WebAssembly 基础上修改的中文网页端 PSP 模拟器，增加了 8MiB 窗口分段读取 ISO、分块断点续传、1x–3x 渲染倍率与触屏手柄支持。
summary.en: Browser PSP emulator modified from PPSSPP WebAssembly, adding 8MiB windowed on-demand ISO reading, resumable chunked downloads, 1x–3x resolution scaling, and touch controls.

zh: ISO 镜像改为按需分段读取（缓存窗口上限 8MiB），避免启动时把整张光盘镜像一次性塞进浏览器内存
支持导入外部 JSON 游戏列表、分块下载暂停与续传、1x–3x 内部渲染分辨率切换及存档导入导出
附带本地运行诊断面板，方便查看帧率、模拟速度、ISO 读取耗时和音频缓冲情况
en: Reads ISO images on demand with an 8MiB cache cap instead of loading the entire disc into browser memory
Supports external JSON game manifests, resumable downloads, 1x–3x resolution scaling, and save import/export
Includes a local diagnostics panel showing frame rate, ISO read latency, and audio buffer metrics

milestone.zh: 已完成按需读取 ISO、分辨率调整与触控按键适配，日常按需修补兼容性。
milestone.en: On-demand ISO reading, resolution scaling, and touch controls are working; maintained for compatibility.
